# nico_dpu_extension_service (Data Source)

DPU Extension Service allows users to run custom services in the DPUs of their Instances. KubernetesPod is delivered through the DPU agent; DpfHelmChart is reconciled through DPF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_dpu_extension_service" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "dpu_extension_service_name" {
  value = data.nico_dpu_extension_service.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dpu_extension_service_id` (String) Path parameter: dpu_extension_service_id.
- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `query` (String) Search for matches across all DPU Extension Services. Input will be matched against name, description, and status fields
- `site_id` (String) Filter DPU Extension Services by Site ID
- `status` (String) Status filter for the DPU Extension Services

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when this version of the DPU Extension Service was created
- `data` (String) Deployment spec for the DPU Extension Service
- `has_credentials` (Boolean) Indicates whether this version was created with credentials
- `observability` (Attributes) Observability configuration for this DPU Extension Service version (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--observability))
- `version` (String) Current version of the DPU Extension Service
